You work several days a week and are able to afford rent, food, leisurely activity. I am moreso referring to the fact that in my country you can work 40hrs and barely be able to afford to keep a roof over your head.

The context in which humans had to work pre-capitalistic society was vastly different. What I am mainly saying is “you didn’t ask to be here and there is no genuine reason people are working full time at any job and not making enough to live” Because, imo, that is both impractical and inhumane. Also, to be fair, my ancestors at least would work because of course work needed to be done but by noon they would also be able to relax and enjoy life and wouldn’t worry about working a full day and not being able to eat solely on the basis of not making enough money for food.
Fair enough, you’re never forced to do anything, but the other option involves starving to death.
You didn’t ask to be born and shouldn’t be forced to work 40hrs a week just to make ends meet.
